Alpha Ladder WealthX Among Asia’s First to Bring xStocks US Tokenised Equities to Institutional and Accredited Investors

Wealth management platform Alpha Ladder WealthX has launched access to xStocks tokenised U.S. equities for eligible institutional and accredited investors in selected APAC markets. The launch follows a collaboration between Alpha Ladder, MetaComp and Kraken’s parent company Payward, with Alpha Ladder serving as a regional distribution partner. xStocks provides economic exposure to the underlying securities without conferring share ownership or voting rights. — link

Around $3 Billion in Bitcoin and Ethereum Options Expire on Deribit as ETH Traders Turn More Defensive

Approximately $2.9 billion to $3 billion in Bitcoin and Ethereum options expired on Deribit, including about $2.53 billion in BTC options and $406 million to $425 million in ETH options. Bitcoin’s put-to-call ratio stood at 0.76, indicating a bullish bias, while Ethereum’s rose to 0.89, suggesting more defensive positioning. Max pain levels were approximately $75,000 for Bitcoin and $2,150 for Ethereum, with relatively limited market volatility following settlement. — link

Canada’s Financial Regulator Says Tokenized Deposits Have the Same Legal Status as Traditional Deposits

Tokenized and other digitally represented deposits are not legally distinct from traditional deposits.

Ethereum Glamsterdam Upgrade Tentatively Set for Sepolia on October 6, Mainnet Date Still Uncertain

Bitwise to Liquidate Dogecoin ETF BWOW, Trading to End October 14

Bitwise announced that it will liquidate and close its Dogecoin ETF (NYSE: BWOW). The fund is expected to cease operations after its final trading day on October 14, 2026, with creations of new shares also ending. Remaining shareholders will receive a cash distribution on October 22 based on the fund’s net asset value as of October 21, with no action required. Bitwise said the liquidation is part of an adjustment to its product lineup. — link
